models.name: todo_list_todolistmembers
models.description:
Authenticated user account for the Todo List system.

Represents a natural person who registers, logs in, and manages their own private todo items. Each account is uniquely identified by email, which is required for login and password recovery. All authentication and data ownership are strictly scoped to this actor – there is no account sharing or joint access.

Password information is stored as a cryptographically secure hash—never in plain text. Sessions are managed in a separate table, providing audit trails and session control. User accounts support full account deletion with immediate and permanent removal of all data. There are no administrative roles or collaborative features in this minimal model.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique user email address for authentication and communication. Must follow proper email format and is used for login and password reset.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographically secure hash of the user's password. Never stored in plain text and required for authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of account creation. Used for audit and compliance purposes.

models.name: todo_list_todolistmember_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for a todoListMember.

This table records session activity including IP, href, referrer, and session timeline. Each session is linked to one todoListMember and represents a unique browser or device login instance. Used for securing API access and providing audit records. Sessions may expire or be invalidated by the system or user action. No sensitive auth credentials are stored here; only association and activity context.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_todolistmember_id
foreignFields.description: References the todoListTodolistmember who owns this session. {@link todo_list_todolistmembers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was created or last accessed. Used for audit and security.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or origin used when session was initialized. Provides context on session creation.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer value (if present) at time of login; commonly HTTP referer header.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was initially created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the session was invalidated, closed by user, or expired. Null if session is still active.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Todo items managed by each authenticated user in the Todo List application.

This table stores all actionable tasks owned by a single user (todolistmember). Each todo is a distinct record with a unique identifier and is strictly associated with its creator, preventing access by other users. Todos are private and enforce per-user title uniqueness as required by business rules.

The model provides minimal yet complete fields to represent task text, an optional longer description, a completion status, timestamps for audit support, and referential integrity to an existing user. No collaboration, sharing, or advanced metadata is present for MVP; only essential CRUD operations are supported. All deletions are irreversible as specified.

Each todo can be created, viewed, updated, and deleted by the owner only; no user or admin may access other users' data at any time.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for each todo item.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_todolistmember_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user account. Enforces strict per-user data isolation. {@link todo_list_todolistmembers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title provided by the owner. Must be unique for each user, between 1 and 100 characters, and non-blank.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional longer details or notes for the todo. Allows up to 1000 characters. Can be null or empty as needed.

plainFields.name: is_complete
plainFields.description: Completion status. True if the todo is marked complete, false if still pending or in progress.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: If set, indicates when the todo was marked complete. Null if not completed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the todo was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for the most recent update to the todo, including status or field edits.
